author: unknown
content:
I can never try things that don't give me instant success/failure
For example if I want to something in the computer language SQL it's quite easy because I can test each line or bit of code easily and quickly. I could write a very short line, run it, add onto it, then repeat etc. Very low stress as I can gradually build onto it.

This is very different from something that requires compiling. In those you can't get an instant yes/no but it takes much longer. A good metaphor is it's like building a house and not knowing if you are doing good until someone buys the house and lives in it. 

I feel like this is stopping from doing things I otherwise want to do, like learning to draw. Seriously I bought a drawing tablet, got YouTube videos bookmarked, but I just can't get myself to start. I feel like it's the house example: I'm not able to start unless I can see the light at the end of the tunnel

Anyone have experience with this?
